# 1 Enoch Chapter 31 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**31:1** And beyond these mountains I saw to the east another great valley, and it was a secret valley. And I saw trees there, tall and beautiful and fragrant, and with a fine-scented-bark like mastic.

**31:2** And on the sides of those valleys I saw aromatic-cinnamon trees, and their bark was reddish and had a [sweet] fragrance. And beyond these things I directed my steps toward the east.

**31:3** And I saw mountains lying beyond that valley, and among them there were trees of great height with their summits reaching to heaven. And I saw that valley in which there were trees of great height with their summits reaching to heaven; and a stream of water flowed beneath those trees.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied. Ch. 31 continues the second journey east: aromatic trees — mastic, cinnamon — and great mountains with towering trees. The text has some repetition in v. 3 which may reflect a manuscript doublet. Where 4QEn (Aramaic) fragments survive, significant variants are noted.*
